fixed_management.notes: The link served the June edition on 2026-10-31, one quarter older than the ACWI fact sheet from the same site. A US-domiciled fund: rules TXF-12 and TXF-27 apply to the holder; ETF-23 and ETF-29 frame how it may be offered in Israel. Its legal form is not printed on this fact sheet, so whether Israeli tax treats it as a company or a trust stays open (tax open question 19, job 1). The prospectus was not opened.

tracking_difference_12m.notes: Not printed as one number. The Fact Sheet as of June 30, 2026 prints the fund's return and its benchmark's for each calendar year 2021 to 2025 on p. 1; they are in tracking_record.
